# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Tier 3 PyInstaller `--exclude-module` lines for transformers.models.<arch>
#
# Pre-staged snapshot. Generated by:
#     UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=<venv> python scripts/list_unused_transformers_models.py
#
# Generation context:
#   - Date generated:     2026-05-08 (UTC)
#   - Platform generated: Linux x86_64
#   - transformers version: 5.7.0
#   - Total architectures in transformers/models/: 459
#   - Allowlist (kept):  22 (see scripts/list_unused_transformers_models.py)
#   - Excluded (below):  437
#   - Estimated saving:  ~1.3 – 2.2 GB bundle size
#
# ── Why this file is checked in ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Tier 3 excludes are NOT applied automatically — they go in only after manual
# end-to-end validation on each target platform (macOS arm64, macOS x86_64,
# Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64). This file is a convenience snapshot so the
# release-cutting flow is: regenerate fresh → diff against this → paste into
# scripts/build_sidecar.py. Not a substitute for regenerating.
#
# ── How to apply ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#   1. Regenerate fresh on the platform you're cutting from:
#        python scripts/list_unused_transformers_models.py > /tmp/fresh.txt
#      Compare to this file. If transformers has released since this snapshot,
#      new architectures have appeared — check if any belong in the allowlist.
#
#   2. Paste the fresh lines into scripts/build_sidecar.py's `cmd` list,
#      directly under the "Tier 3" header comment block.
#
#   3. Rebuild:  uv run python scripts/build_sidecar.py
#
#   4. End-to-end smoke EVERY tier on a real corpus:
#        - T0 text query
#        - T1 code query
#        - T2 PDF query
#        - T3 vision-PDF query
#        - T4 ColPali query
#      Each tier exercises different transformers-loading paths. If anything
#      ImportErrors at runtime → identify the missing arch → ADD it to
#      ALLOWLIST in scripts/list_unused_transformers_models.py → regenerate.
#
#   5. Repeat steps 3–4 on each target platform. Only after green on all
#      platforms: commit the new T3 lines, tag the release.
#
# ── ⚠ Architectures worth re-checking before applying ────────────────────────
# These showed up in the EXCLUDED set but might need to move to the allowlist
# depending on the active colpali-engine / sentence-transformers versions:
#
#   transformers.models.colpali           — transformers 5.x has native ColPali
#   transformers.models.colqwen2          — same; native ColQwen2 dispatch
#   transformers.models.colmodernvbert    — same; native ColModernVBert dispatch
#
# colpali-engine historically had its own wrapper, but newer transformers
# releases provide built-in ColPali variants. AutoModel.from_pretrained() may
# now dispatch to the transformers.* path, in which case excluding these
# breaks ColPali at runtime (T4). Validate carefully on T4.
#
#   transformers.models.qwen3_vl          — if colpali-engine adds ColQwen3VL,
#   transformers.models.qwen3_vl_moe        these need to move to allowlist.
#
#   transformers.models.gemma3n           — gemma3n is a distinct variant from
#                                           gemma3 (which IS in allowlist).
#                                           Almost certainly safe to exclude;
#                                           flag only.
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
